<?php

function divisors($num) {
    $ret = array();
    $i = 2;
    for (; $i * $i < $num; $i++) {
        if ($num % $i == 0) {
            $ret[] = $i;
            $ret[] = intdiv($num, $i);
        }
    }
    if ($i * $i == $num) {
        $ret[] = $i;
    }
    return $ret;
}

while (($line = fgets(STDIN)) !== false) {
    $parts = preg_split('/\s+/', trim($line));
    if (count($parts) < 3) {
        continue;
    }
    $n = intval($parts[0]);
    $m = intval($parts[1]);
    $k = intval($parts[2]);

    if ($n % 2 == 0) {
        echo "Marsel\n";
        continue;
    }

    $div = divisors($m);
    $flag = false;
    if ($m > 1) {
        $div[] = 1;
    }
    for ($i = 0; $i < count($div) && !$flag; $i++) {
        if ($div[$i] >= $k) {
            $flag = true;
        }
    }
    if ($flag) {
        echo "Timur\n";
    } else {
        echo "Marsel\n";
    }
}

source_data.prob_desc_description: Two beavers, Timur and Marsel, play the following game.There are n logs, each of exactly m meters in length. The beavers move in turns. For each move a beaver chooses a log and gnaws it into some number (more than one) of equal parts, the length of each one is expressed by an integer and is no less than k meters. Each resulting part is also a log which can be gnawed in future by any beaver. The beaver that can't make a move loses. Thus, the other beaver wins.Timur makes the first move. The players play in the optimal way. Determine the winner.
source_data.prob_desc_output_spec: Print "Timur", if Timur wins, or "Marsel", if Marsel wins. You should print everything without the quotes.
source_data.prob_desc_input_spec: The first line contains three integers n, m, k (1 ≤ n, m, k ≤ 109).
source_data.prob_desc_notes: NoteIn the first sample the beavers only have one log, of 15 meters in length. Timur moves first. The only move he can do is to split the log into 3 parts each 5 meters in length. Then Marsel moves but he can't split any of the resulting logs, as k = 4. Thus, the winner is Timur.In the second example the beavers have 4 logs 9 meters in length. Timur can't split any of them, so that the resulting parts possessed the length of not less than 5 meters, that's why he loses instantly.
